description: Search Lancet articles offline and analyze author impact, institutional networks, and editorial trends — powered by the free OpenAlex scholarly graph.

tools.name: authors_get
tools.description: Get a single author by OpenAlex ID. Required: id. Returns array of AuthorsGetItem.

tools.name: authors_search
tools.description: Search authors. Optional: search, filter, per-page (default: 25) (plus 1 more). Returns array of Author.

tools.name: sources_get
tools.description: Get a journal (source) by ISSN or OpenAlex ID. Required: id. Returns the Source.

params.name: id
params.description: Journal ISSN prefixed with issn: (e.g. issn:0140-6736) or OpenAlex source ID (S...)

tools.name: works_get
tools.description: Get a single article by OpenAlex ID or DOI. Required: id. Returns array of WorksGetItem.

params.name: id
params.description: OpenAlex work ID (W...) or DOI prefixed with doi: (e.g. doi:10.1016/S0140-6736(23)01234-5)

tools.name: works_search
tools.description: Search Lancet articles (works). Optional: search, filter, sort (plus 3 more). Returns array of Work.

params.name: search
params.description: Full-text search across title, abstract, and fulltext

params.name: filter
params.description: OpenAlex filter expression. Scope to a journal with primary_location.source.issn:0140-6736, add date bounds with from_publication_date:2023-01-01,to_publication_date:2024-12-31, or open access with is_oa:true.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return (reduces payload size)
